bearingSource: OSM long axis of way 267015840 (main church, 137.5°); +X points to the rounded altar end (south-east), the entrance porch and tower face −X (north-west).
approximations: Model of the main church (the building of the research record). Heights estimated from photos 01 and 03 with the drum diameter and the 13.8 m front as the scale (eave ≈12 m, drum to ≈26 m, cross ≈41.5 m); the north and east sides are not photographed; mosaics, arcades and banding simplified; terraces and the wooden bell tower omitted. Metal: the church photographs (2007, Jan 2018) show grey sheet-metal roofs, and the only copper visible at Rohia is on the new Nicolae Steinhardt cultural centre (Jan 2018 photos 04–05, about 100 m north-east of the church, under scaffolding, not in OSM, not modelled). COLOR METAL's records list copper for Rohia in 2019, after all church photographs, without naming the building; following the client rule, the church roofs, tower skirt, flared eave and spire are shown in weathered copper. If the 2019 copper went to the Steinhardt centre, the church roofs should revert to grey sheet (one constant in the model) or the record should be re-pointed to the centre.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii publice de referință ale bisericii mari a mănăstirii; înălțimile, laturile de nord și de est și decorul sunt aproximate. Fotografiile bisericii sunt anterioare livrării de cupru din 2019, de aceea acoperișurile și turla sunt redate în cupru patinat, conform evidențelor COLOR METAL; clădirea care a primit cuprul nu este precizată în surse.
note.hu: A kolostor főtemplomának nyilvános referenciafotói alapján értelmezett makett; a magasságok, az északi és keleti oldal és a díszítés közelítőek. A templomról készült fotók a 2019-es rézszállítás előttiek, ezért a tetők és a torony a COLOR METAL nyilvántartása szerint patinásodott rézzel jelennek meg; hogy melyik épület kapta a rezet, a források nem rögzítik.
note.en: Scale model of the monastery's main church interpreted from public reference photographs; heights, the north and east sides and the decoration are approximate. The church photographs predate the 2019 copper delivery, so the roofs and the tower are shown in weathered copper according to COLOR METAL's records; which building received the copper is not stated in the sources.
